title: Guess a capacity, check it greedily, binary search the guess

steps.caption: Ship packages in order within 5 days. Capacity is at least the heaviest package (10) and at most everything at once (55).
Capacity 32: fill each day greedily → 2 days. Fits: try smaller.
Capacity 21: fill each day greedily → 3 days. Fits: try smaller.
Capacity 15: fill each day greedily → 5 days. Fits: try smaller.
Capacity 12: fill each day greedily → 6 days. Too many days: need more capacity.
Capacity 14: fill each day greedily → 6 days. Too many days: need more capacity.
Smallest capacity that works: 15. The check is a greedy O(n) pass; binary search calls it O(log(sum)) times.
